subject: general
question: In 1996, Dr. Indira PP Bora, an exponent of Sattriya, was honoured with the
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian** Satriya dancer Dr. Indira P. P. Bora** is from **Assam**. 
 
• She received 13 years of **training **in **Bharatnatyam** from **Guru Rukmini Devi Arundale** and **Kuchipudi **from **Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam**.
 
• Bora has **performed **and promoted **Satriya **in **Vietnam**, the **United States**, and **New Zealand**.
 
• She was awarded various awards including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1996** and **Padma Shri in 2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sattriya Dance has its origin in the ‘Sattras’ established by Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev in the 15th and 16th centuries. 

 
 
• The **Sattras **were established for the **propagation of Vaishnavism **and later became the religious, cultural and social hub of **Assam**.
 
• The Sattriya dance can be classified into two styles, namely ‘Paurashik Bhangi’ i.e. Tandava or Masculine style and ‘Stri Bhangi’ i.e. Lashya or feminine style.
 
• On November 15 in the year 2000, the Sangeet Natak Akademi of India recognized Sattriya as one of the eight classical dances of India.
 
 
 
• ​**Sangeet Natak Akademi**:
 
 
• It is the apex body in the field of performing arts in the country and was set up in 1953 for the preservation and promotion of the vast intangible heritage of India’s diverse culture expressed in forms of music, dance and drama.
 
• The Chairman of the Akademi is appointed by the President of India for a term of five years.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi is an autonomous body of the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• The registered office of the Akademi is at Rabindra Bhavan, New Delhi.
 
 
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards** are the **highest national recognition conferred on practicing artists**.
 
 
• It is India's National Academy of **Music**, **Dance **& **Drama**, also called the Akademi Puraskar.
 
• It is the greatest honor bestowed upon those involved in the performing arts in India.
 
• **1952 **marked its **initial award**.
